name: Dhimas Alfian Sahara - Electronics Engineering
description: I am a Diploma III graduate of Electronic Engineering with an educational background and experience focusing on electronic systems, microcontroller programming, and hardware design and development. I have technical skills in designing, implementing, and maintaining efficient and applicable electronic and automation-based systems. During my studies, I was accustomed to working with various devices and platforms such as Arduino, PLC, sensors, actuators, and utilizing design and simulation software such as Proteus and EAGLE to support the electronic system design process. These skills support me in completing various projects involving the integration of hardware and software. I have an interest and experience in developing automation systems, Internet of Things (IoT) technology, and robotics, with an approach that emphasizes practical solutions for industrial and social needs. The ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team, as well as a disciplined, meticulous, and responsible attitude, are added values ​​in completing work professionally. In addition to technical competence, I also have a strong commitment to continue to follow the latest developments in the fields of computer and electronics engineering, and strive to apply these innovations in real life to provide a positive impact on society. I believe that expertise in technology is not only limited to applications in the industrial world, but can also be used as a tool to inspire, empower, and create real solutions that are widely beneficial. Therefore, I continue to try to develop myself and actively contribute to the development of relevant, applicable, and impactful technology.
